title_zh: 约定为角色转变补足动机并调整场景次序

scenario.label_zh: 约定为角色转变补足动机并调整场景次序
scenario.goal_zh: 指出角色转变过快的问题，并约定将警告放在冒险决定前、补充试探性行动

context_zh: 两位写作者讨论原创虚构短剧的情节，不涉及已有作品改写。
author: author-phase09-b

sentences.speaker: Verity
sentences.text: Mara's main trait is caution, but in the next scene she takes a huge risk. Does the transition feel convincing?

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Not yet. One friendly conversation can't transform her entire outlook. What changes her mind?

sentences.speaker: Verity
sentences.text: She subsequently learns that the bridge is closing. In the current draft, that news comes after she's already decided to leave.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Move the warning earlier. Then her decision has a reason, rather than just serving the plot.

sentences.speaker: Verity
sentences.text: And in the subsequent scene, she could test the first part of the route before committing to the whole journey.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Yes. That preserves her caution while showing why she's willing to act.

sentences.speaker: Verity
sentences.text: I'll move the warning before the decision and add that small test afterwards.

sentences.speaker: Omar
sentences.text: Good. Then we can read the three scenes together and see whether the change feels earned.
